Camera exact focal editor and slider share CameraLens.focalLengthRange (14...200 mm). All presets lie within it. Exact XYZ controls use Position.coordinateRange (-100...100 meters), while quick sliders use -4...4, 0...4, -6...6 and expand to include finite imported coordinates. CameraFraming validates lens, requires subject distance >=0.05 m, and uses EmitterFrame which checks source/target Position.isValid. Projected points must also be valid and at least 0.05 m in front. Near/coincident cameras yield a visible move-away warning rather than invalid coverage.

Focal and XYZ sliders supply meaningful labels, localized exact accessible values, and stable identifiers. Exact buttons expose action labels, values, and numeric-editor hints. Presets expose millimeter labels and selected traits, with the numerical focal readout independently conveying current value. Accessibility text sizes switch label/value layout to vertical and preset grid to two columns; controls declare 44-point minimum height.
